issue.title: Key of Awakening can be assembled with only two fragments
issue.description: The combine action creates the complete Key of Awakening when the player has only two of the three key fragments.
issue.expected_behavior: Combining key fragments should require all three fragments before producing the complete Key of Awakening.
issue.observed_fault: The player can assemble the complete key with only two fragments instead of all three.
reproduction: Reach a state with exactly two of the three key fragments in inventory.
Observe that the complete Key of Awakening is created before the third fragment is present.
issue.root_cause: `ActionHandler.handle_combine` checks for fewer than two fragments instead of fewer than three, so the final key assembly gate is off by one.
